    🚢 Mia Checkpoint, "Mia Checkpoint (checkpoint)"¶

    A Vennerian checkpoint in the northeast of Mia island, north of the Lumina Continent continent. The checkpoint controls passage through the island's forested terrain and serves as a waystation for Vennerian Trade Republic vessels operating in the northern waters.

    🕸️ Connections¶

    • Controller: Vennerian Trade Republic
    • Island: Mia
    • Region: North of Lumina Continent
